name: O2
verdict: O2 is the consumer mobile brand of Virgin Media O2, a 50:50 joint venture between Liberty Global and Telefónica; neither JV parent is state-controlled. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: proposed none for issue #714 (2026-09-30). Chain: Saudi Arabia's PIF holds 9.97% of Telefónica voting rights indirectly (Green Bridge / stc), so its effective holding in the 50:50 JV Virgin Media O2 is ~4.99% - under the 5% threshold, and the stc-nominated proprietary director sits on Telefónica's board, not the sponsor's. SEPI (Spain) 10.00% x 50% = 5.0%, but Spain has no sourced serious-abuse record, and state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md). Liberty Global is NASDAQ-listed with no state in the chain. Front-of-shirt sponsor of England Rugby (men and women) to 2031 per the RFU's 20 Nov 2025 announcement.
